_comment: Co-op relay for the packaged desktop/Steam build. Empty = multiplayer disabled, solo play unaffected. Overridden at runtime by the MOJI_RELAY_URL env var, and at build time by the MOJI_RELAY_URL Actions variable (see .github/workflows/steam-build.yml). This is the host defined in render.yaml; verify it with `node scripts/relay_health_check.mjs` before shipping. NOTE: the Render free plan sleeps after ~15 min idle and takes ~90s to wake — the first player to join a cold relay waits. Move to mp-cf/ (Cloudflare Worker, no cold start) or a paid plan to remove that wait.
